supported: Continuous structural Facts remain preferable to coarse state compression as the computational representation under the accepted development evidence.
Layered Stage propositions preserve explicit parent-context plus nested-condition semantics that forced single-code compression can elide.
The current Facts-plus-Layered product packet communicates already-derived Stage10/11 state more reliably than the current Facts-only packet on the frozen P033 consumer task.
not_supported: Pure layered-presentation causality under information-equivalent Facts inputs.
Strict historical point-in-time or as-known validity for the 2020 retrospective evidence.
Predictive utility, economic superiority, out-of-sample performance, production expert authority, strategy authority or trading authority.
A requirement that every historical stage code be qualified or promoted.

allowed_triggers: A concrete downstream expert or multi-expert consumer exposes a bounded semantic/communication gap that cannot be addressed by the existing Continuous Facts plus Layered Proposition contract.
Independently obtained admissible evidence appears that materially changes a previously blocked claim boundary, with a new preregistered review before any result-bearing execution.
A prospective auditable workflow creates a new business need for Stage semantics and defines its own point-in-time evidence from collection start onward.
insufficient_triggers: Completing or beautifying the historical 0-12 taxonomy.
Qualifying every historical stage code for symmetry or completeness.
Re-running consumed partitions or searching more historical data sources solely to rescue a blocked Stage claim.
Improving a metric after observing a prior result without a separately preregistered business question.
required_before_reopen: Frozen evidence population and knowledge-time semantics.
Preregistered success, no-pass and stop conditions.
Independent review when the new question changes an existing claim boundary.

claim_ceiling: Stock-stage research phase 1 is closed as a converged architecture and evidence boundary. Continuous Facts remain authoritative; Layered Stage propositions remain a governed development semantic/communication surface. No new Stage experiment, P034, qualification, PIT, prediction, economics, production, strategy or trading authority is created by this closeout.
